Seamlessly blends theoretical knowledge with hands-on training. Covers key areas of computer science including programming, IT fundamentals and software development. Vision To be a leading centre of academic excellence by fostering innovation in teaching, learning and research, while equipping students for success in the field of computer science and technology. Mission The Department of Computer Applications at SSMRV aims to deliver high-quality education that equips students with comprehensive knowledge and essential skills in computer science and technology.
